snippet.title: Garden of Oblivion (Steam Trailer)
snippet.description:
Trailer for the upcoming Steam Edition of the short horror point & click game Garden of Oblivion. A teenager awakens in a dream-like garden. Will Reven be able to escape? It's up to you!

Out on Steam the 9th March: http://store.steampowered.com/app/761070/Garden_of_Oblivion/

Video editing by Amy Smith: http://www.obsessedillusionist.com/
